items.title: A finite type morphism between regular schemes is a local complete intersection morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y locally of finite type with X and Y regular, the lemma concludes f is lci. The retained proof is written: factor f locally as an immersion X -> A^n_Y followed by the projection (standard locally-of-finite-type factorization); the affine space over a regular base is regular (Algebra, lemma regular-goes-up — regularity ascending along polynomial extensions); an immersion between regular schemes with the target's local rings regular is a regular immersion (Divisors, lemma immersion-regular-regular-immersion); a morphism factorable as regular-immersion-then-smooth is lci by the chapter's own lci-properties dictionary (definition via local factorizations). Retained author proof at lines 18344-18351.
